a.title: How Berlin's Arab queers are building their community
a.summary: As the co-founder of the ADIRA Drag Festival, Lebanese performance artist, drag performer, DJ and cultural organizer Hassandra has become an essential part of Berlin's queer artistic landscape.

b.title: Wie Berlins arabische Queers ihre Community aufbauen
b.summary: Hassandra gehört zu den bekanntesten Stimmen der queeren arabischen Kunstszene in Berlin. Mit dem 2023 gegründeten ADIRA Drag Festival schafft Hassandra gemeinsam mit anderen, Räume für Austausch und Gemeinschaft.

a.title: Is Israel opposition figure Gadi Eisenkot going to replace Benjamin Netanyahu?
a.summary: In Israel, Gadi Eisenkot emerged on Thursday, November 5, as the frontrunner to be tasked with forming a government. This comes after one of the two main parties representing ultra-Orthodox Jewish voters – a longtime ally of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's coalition – declined to recommend any candidate for the task. FRANCE 24's correspondent in Jerusalem Noga Tarnopolsky reports.

b.title: Finalizan consultas políticas en Israel con Eisenkot sumando apoyos
b.summary: Las negociaciones de Gadi Eisenkot avanzan para formar Gobierno y multiplica sus apoyos, incluso con algunos de los partidos árabes, el primer ministro Benjamin Netanyahu perdió el respaldo de la lista ultraortodoxa Judaísmo Unido de la Torá, que se negó a apoyar a un candidato.
